title: BSC offline research stage activation independent audit
objective: Independently audit BSC-OFFLINE-RESEARCH-STAGE-ACTIVATION-001. Verify the activation is offline-local-research only; Solana remains the sole Live/production delivery chain; BSC network collection, Live providers, resident listeners, GMGN automation, real trades, and production database writes remain prohibited; Robinhood stays BLOCKED_STAGE; and BSC Source Inventory is not marked READY prematurely. Evaluate Harness adherence, simplicity, architecture, data credibility, product closure, tests/observability, security/privacy, Git/task governance, strengths, issues, over-implementation, P0/P1/P2, and issue exactly GREEN, YELLOW, or RED.
forbidden_actions: Do not execute real trades, sign transactions, broadcast transactions, or connect a trading wallet.
Do not read seed phrases, private keys, browser cookies, login sessions, DPAPI material, or trading API keys.
Do not automate a logged-in GMGN page; only consume user-provided offline exports from the private root.
Do not commit wallet addresses, transaction hashes, raw GMGN exports, chainfm_out contents, or private manifests containing raw records.
Do not treat null, unknown, or missing values as zero.
Do not create a cross-chain global wallet score or assume SOL and BSC addresses identify the same entity.
Do not squash, rebase, rewrite pushed history, push to main, or merge a PR.
Do not modify product source, tests, configuration, task status, implementation artifacts, or the audited task specification.
The auditor must not be the BSC-OFFLINE-RESEARCH-STAGE-ACTIVATION-001 implementer.
